'''Marauder King Corthan''' was the last ruling king of the [[Corthan|Kingdom of Corthan]],<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|37|A King's Plea}}</ref> an ancient, warlike civilization of Azotha<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1274061839482753157 Moriena from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] (dead link) - "Corthan was a kingdom of the Azotha"</ref><ref>[[The History of Corthan]]</ref> who lived in the present-day Badlands prior to the founding of the Arathi Empire.<ref>[https://discord.com/channels/466622455805378571/528228771594240030/1086439363199635568 Gheor from the Turtle WoW Community Discord] (dead link) - "The Kingdom of Corthan predates the Arathor Empire. Corthan mentions rebels going up north of the now Badlands and implies they have gone back into a tribal state - thus being the first step towards the Empire of Arathor."</ref> Corthan was not his true name; Corthanian custom mandated that all Marauder Kings had to eponymously re-christen themselves as Corthan upon becoming ruler.

== History ==
Corthan was crowned at the temple in the city of [[Corthan]].<ref>{{questlong|Neutral|37|The Land of Kings}}</ref> The king would go on to subjugate a number of lesser warlords. At some point during his reign, Corthan entered into a betrothal with the daughter of the Keeper of Zeth (the main religion of Corthan), Zetharia. At the day of their marriage, Corthan arrived with his commoner mistress, enraging Zetharia.

Zetharia, overcome with anger at Corthan's unfaithfulness, brokered a deal with the Lord of Everlasting Death, and conjured a powerful curse that trapped the kingdom and its inhabitants - including Corthan himself - in an existence of eternal undeath.

It is a combination of ancient [[centaur]] burial grounds, as well as a primal temple dedicated to the elemental earth. ==History== From the [https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Game_Guide/World_Dungeons World Dungeons] page on the official World of Warcraft Community Site: :''Protected by the fierce Maraudine centaur, Maraudon is one of the most sacred sites within Desolace. The great temple/cavern is the burial place of Zaetar, one of two immortal sons born to the demigod, Cenarius. Legend holds that Zaetar and the earth elemental princess, Theradras, sired the misbegotten centaur race. It is said that upon their emergence, the barbaric centaur turned on their father and killed him. Some believe that Theradras, in her grief, trapped Zaetar's spirit within the winding cavern - used its energies for some malign purpose. The subterranean tunnels are populated by the vicious, long-dead ghosts of the Centaur Khans, as well as Theradras' own raging, elemental minions.'' ==Geography== ===Maps and subregions=== File:WorldMap-MaraudonEntrance.jpg|Exterior File:WorldMap-Maraudon.jpg|Interior {| class="fandom-table" |- |[[Earth Song Falls]] • [[Foulspore Cavern]] • [[Noxious Hollow|The Noxious Hollow]] • [[Poison Falls]] • [[Vyletongue Seat]] • [[Wicked Grotto|The Wicked Grotto]] • [[Zaetar's Grave]] |} {{clrl}} == Dungeon denizens == * {{RaceIcon|Basilisk}} [[Basilisk]]s * {{RaceIcon|BogBeast}} [[Bog beast]]s * {{RaceIcon|Centaur|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Centaur|Female}} [[Centaur]]s * {{RaceIcon|Crocolisk}} [[Crocolisk]]s (one, [[Rotgrip]]) * {{RaceIcon|Diemetradon}} [[Diemetradon]]s * {{RaceIcon|Cenarian|Female}} [[Dryad]]s * {{RaceIcon|Earth}} [[Earth elemental]]s * {{RaceIcon|Ghost}} [[Ghost]]s * {{RaceIcon|Goblin|Male}} [[Goblin]]s (one, [[Tinkerer Gizlock]]) * {{RaceIcon|Grell}} [[Grell]]s * {{RaceIcon|Hydra}} [[Hydra]]s * {{RaceIcon|Lasher}} [[Lasher]]s * {{RaceIcon|Larva}} [[Larva]]e * {{RaceIcon|Cenarian|Male}} [[Keeper of the grove|Keeper]]s * {{RaceIcon|MountainGiant}} [[Mountain giant]]s * {{RaceIcon|Ooze}} [[Ooze]]s * {{RaceIcon|Satyr|Male}}{{RaceIcon|Satyr|Female}} [[Satyr]] * {{RaceIcon|Treant}} [[Treant]]s * {{RaceIcon|Turtle}} [[Turtle]]s * {{RaceIcon|PlagueWater}} [[Water elemental]]s (one, [[Noxxion]]) * {{RaceIcon|Worm}} [[Worm]]s == Quest guide == {| class="fandom-table" |- !Quest name !Quest giver !Zone location |- ! '''Mathias and the Defias''' is a [[rogue]] [[quest]] available at level 20.  The quest is began by talking to [[Mathias Shaw]] in [[Stormwind]].

==Objective==
Travel to Westfall and find [[Amber Kearnen|Agent Kearnen]] for your debriefing.

Agent Kearnen is well hidden just to the north of the defias tower and under a small tree.

==Description==
Not a moment too soon, <name>. [[SI:7]] reconnaissance is reporting unusually heavy Defias activity in [[Westfall]].

It would seem that the Defias have taken over an abandoned [[Mortwake's Tower|Alliance watch tower]] southeast of [[Sentinel Hill]] and are using it as a base of operations to smuggle in goods from the [[Redridge]] supply route.

Get to Westfall and contact Agent Kearnen for your debriefing. You will find her hidden near the tower.

...and <name>, should you be discovered, SI:7 will disavow all knowledge of your existence.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*390 [[XP]]

==Completion==
Mathias finally sent another agent to back me up, eh? Well I hope he's ready to hear some bad news.

==Progression==
{{Touch of Zanzil}}

[[Image:The Master's Cellar.jpg|thumb|300px|The Master's Cellar]]

The '''Master's Cellar''' is an area riddled with [[ghost]]s in the southernmost portion of the [[Deadwind Pass]], just south of [[Karazhan]]. It is below the ruins of a small village, probably the former home of servants that worked in the nearby tower of [[Karazhan]]. 

There are two separate entrances to the Master's Cellar. One leads into a vast wine cellar, filled to the brim with [[Unliving Resident]]s, [[Unliving Caretaker]]s, [[Damned Soul]]s, [[Restless Shade]]s, and [[Wailing Spectre]]s. [[Groundskeeper Jacoby]], who yet still lives and continues to tend to the grounds, hides within the wine cellar and emerges only when not a living soul is looking.<ref name="Mystery">{{Alliance}} [60+] [[The Mystery of Karazhan V]]</ref><ref name="Depths">{{Horde}} [60+] [[The Depths of Karazhan V]]</ref> The other leads into a similar cellar, but here the floor has collapsed into a cave system leading deep underground. The second cellar and cave system are also filled with the same type of [[undead]], as well as being the haunting grounds of [[Captain Rothynn]], once a member of the tower guard.<ref name="Mystery" /><ref name="Depths" />

[[Image:oldgod.jpg|thumb|The Master's Glaive]]

The '''Master's Glaive''' {{coords|39|87|Darkshore}} is located in the southwest part of [[Darkshore]]. To the west of Darkshore stands a mysterious monument, a massive [[adamantine]] [[glaive]] buried in an unmovable boulder called the Old God Skull. The [[night elves]] consider this a sacred area, as they believe the mysterious [[titan]]s, creators of the [[Azeroth (world)|world]], are the only ones who could have wielded the gigantic glaive. It appears as a snail shell-like skull, with a massive weapon embedded in the crown. It is the site of an enormous skeletal [[forgotten one]] in an "adventure hook". It is believed that a titan killed one of the Old Gods or one of their minions here.

This unusual monument is surrounded by a small lake. While it was once a night elf holy place, the area is now under the control of the [[Twilight’s Hammer]]. They believe the statue is some sort of divine corpse — the remains of an [[Old God]]. The term "Master’s Glaive" refers to part of the monument — the sword embedded in the skull.

There are rumors of a complex underground labyrinth underneath the remains in an "adventure hook".

The shell has holes where presumably eyes should be, and tentacles are draped around the area, giving it an appearance similar to a [[kraken]]. The Twilight's Hammer have chosen it as a location for one of their dark altars.
